descrizione: The Sixth Sense is a 1999 American psychological thriller film written and directed by M. Night Shyamalan. It stars Bruce Willis as a child psychologist whose patient (Haley Joel Osment) claims he can see and talk to the dead.

recensioni.estratto: “The Sixth Sense” isn’t a thriller in the modern sense, but more of a ghost story of the sort that flourished years ago, when ordinary people glimpsed hidden dimensions.
An unnerving and astonishing thriller. It's a psychological thriller that actually thrills. The tension rises slowly.
The storytelling itself is brilliant. At running time 1 h 45 min, this is a perfectly paced film.
Sure, the ending of 'The Sixth Sense' is a stretcher–but perfectly ...
Shyamalan's script is a clever construct, but also contains a great deal of sensitivity to the plight of the 'different' child.
Chalk this film up as an unusually intelligent thriller about that which scares us the most: accepting our accidents of fate.
